description:
Free start times for a service, in the salon's time zone, for up to 7 days starting at dateFrom
(default today), optionally for one master. The salon's own rules apply (minimum notice, how far ahead
one may book). Returns at most 60 times grouped by date, with masters free at each time, and the
bookingUrl where the person picks the time and books.

dateFrom.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the salon's time zone. Default: today.

masterId.description: Only this master (id from the service's masters).

serviceId.description: Service id from search_services or get_salon.

name: get_available_slots
title: Свободное время
